name: Shark
intro: A shark is a fish that lives in the ocean. There are many kinds of sharks, big and small.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A shark is a fish.
Its body has no bones.
Its skeleton is soft and bendy, like your nose and ears.
Its skin has tiny scales that feel like sandpaper.
It has gill slits on the sides of its head.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Sharks live in the ocean.
Some sharks live near warm coral reefs.
Some live deep down in the sea.
Some even swim under the cold Arctic ice.
Leopard sharks swim close to the ocean floor.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Most sharks are predators.
Most sharks hunt fish.
Some sharks eat crabs and worms.
The giant whale shark eats tiny animals called krill.
Sharks can smell food from far away.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby shark is called a pup.
Some sharks lay eggs in tough cases.
Many sharks give birth to live pups.
A pup is born with a full set of teeth.
Sharks grow new teeth all the time.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: There are more than 500 kinds of sharks.
The whale shark is the biggest fish in the world.
The dwarf lantern shark is about as long as a hand.
Sharks lived on Earth long before the dinosaurs.
Sharks can feel tiny electric signals from other animals.

vocab.meaning: Soft, bendy stuff, like the inside of your ear.
